decision_note: On 2026-11-12 the project owner decided to open the chat on the public website for the course demo. This is an owner decision, not a completed rights or readiness review: the checks under release_gates were not verified and stay false.

owner_decision.decided_by: Project owner (repository and Vercel project owner), stated in a working session
values_released_to_chat: DMF monthly petroleum production (catalog.dmf.go.th, Open Data Common label)
EPPO refinery intake and petroleum product output (catalog.eppo.go.th, Open Data Common label)
NSO Statistical Yearbook 2026 energy tables 13.5-13.10 (public download)
Permpool, Ghani & Gheewala (2020) Tables 1-6 (inventory and the study's own reported Well-to-Wheels results) and summary notes (CC BY 4.0)
values_withheld_from_chat: Thai Oil and SPRC sustainability-report metrics: described and linked only, no values
Ethanol case evidence (E10 vehicle test, TSM wastewater PDD): described and linked only, no values
accepted_without_verification: Specific reuse terms of the DMF, EPPO and NSO downloads were not confirmed with the agencies
Gemini API audience eligibility and billing state were not confirmed
No Vercel WAF rate limit is configured; only a per-instance limiter in the function
No independent user acceptance test, capacity test or rollback drill was run
owner_decision.credential_note: The owner reported that the Gemini key disclosed in chat was replaced. This was not independently verified and no key value was read.
